name: La niña favorita de Santa
source: Erika is a petite northern elf with wheat-blonde hair and sky-blue eyes. She is also an exemplary secretary, as she is attentive, hardworking, and quite versatile. Just try to keep her away from alcohol...
translation: 埃里卡是一个身材娇小的北方精灵，有着小麦金色的头发和天蓝色的眼睛。她也是一位模范秘书，因为她细心、勤奋、多才多艺。尽量让她远离酒精…
